channel.title: Values :: Pages
channel.description: What an expression makes of a value that is not plain text: a missing weight, zero, padding, a list, a map, and one key holding numbers and text alike. Five children, Copper, Iron, Lead, Tin and Zinc. Tin weighs 10, Copper 20 and Iron 30; Lead and Zinc are unweighted. Their rank is the number -1 for Tin, 1 for Lead and 2 for Copper, but the text x for Iron and the text 10 for Zinc.

item.title: Tin
item.description: Weighs 10, the lightest. Its rank is the number -1.

item.title: Copper
item.description: Weighs 20. Its crew is a list and its author a map, its note is padded with spaces, and its rank is the number 2.

item.title: Iron
item.description: Weighs 30. Its count is zero, its crew a list of one, and its rank the text x.

item.title: Lead
item.description: Unweighted. Its rank is the number 1.

item.title: Zinc
item.description: Unweighted. Its note is unpadded, and its rank the text 10.
